visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a brown sweatshirt and a woman in a white turtleneck sit at a gray table in a modern studio with a concrete-style wall featuring the logo 'THE DODO MEN'. The man reads a book while the woman watches him curiously. (2) Two more people appear behind them holding champagne glasses in a celebratory pose. The man at the table looks distressed, squinting his eyes and covering his face. (3) The man dramatically puts on a leather jacket and holds a champagne glass while the woman pours water from a white electric kettle into it. The background remains the studio setting with a floral arrangement. (4) The man is shown laughing and crying hysterically, pointing upwards with an exaggerated expression. He is then seen in a bright indoor hallway turning off a light switch and walking away. (5) The man stands in the studio holding a black tumbler, smiling and drinking from it. Close-up shots of a smartphone show a Taiwan Mobile promotional interface with a yellow duck mascot. (6) The man interacts with a laptop in a bedroom/living room setting, showing screens of video uploads. He gestures with thumbs up and heart shapes towards the camera in the studio. (7) Final sequence shows the man speaking directly to the camera with various informative text overlays appearing around him to explain a service plan.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous skit about a 'heartbreak' involving the Earth to transition into a lifestyle endorsement for Taiwan Mobile. It emphasizes how using Wi-Fi 6 at home can be an eco-friendly habit (saving energy/battery) and promotes a bundled 5G and fiber internet plan.
